footer.tagline: Track your power. Chase your records.
footer.description: Best Ride is a project made by Simone Fusar Bassini. A cyclist who takes care about his performance and wants that him and other riders can achieve their goals.

site-info.about: Best Ride analyzes your cycling activities directly from your .fit files — no manual data entry. Upload a ride and get an instant, detailed breakdown of your performance.

upload.title: 1. Upload
upload.description: Drop your .fit file from any bike computer or app

analyze.title: 2. Analyze
analyze.description: Get your full power curve, speed, cadence and heart rate breakdown

records.title: 3. Beat your records
records.description: Every ride is checked against your personal bests, automatically

dropzone.dropFile: Drop your .fit file here, or click to browse

results.recordAchievements: Here are the record achievements from this ride:

activity-records-panel.title: Activity Records
activity-records-panel.noRecords: No record data available for this activity.

tutorial.title: Tutorial & Guide
tutorial.eyebrow: Discover how to get the most out of Best Ride and analyze your cycling performance.

intro.title: What is Best Ride
intro.text: is a web application created by
intro.mobileText: is a free web application created by Simone Fusar Bassini to offer you detailed cycling analytics centered around your personal records.
intro.highlight: The goal is to provide advanced features — which are paid on competing applications — completely free of charge.

outro.title: Ready to go?
outro.text: Enjoy the experience and discover how far you can push your limits!

steps.title: Registration
steps.description: By registering, you allow us to process essential personal information. This enables us to provide deeper, more accurate, and complete analytics.

steps.title: Profile Setup
steps.description: We ask you to enter key data, such as FTP, weight, date of birth, and other details required to accurately compute your activity metrics.

steps.title: Historical Records Entry
steps.description: From the records page, you can manually enter your historical best power outputs and performances. If you prefer to skip this, tracking will begin automatically from your first uploaded activity.

steps.title: Activity Upload (.FIT)
steps.description: This is the core feature of the application. Upload the .fit file exported from your bike computer or its companion app.

infoBox.title: Example for Bryton (Active App):
infoBox.description: Once saved in the app, share the file to Google Drive (or another cloud storage) as a .zip archive. Extract the zip file to obtain the .fit file to upload on Best Ride.
infoBox.note: * We are working on automatic direct syncing, but this manual step is currently required.

steps.title: Preview & Verification
steps.description: Once uploaded, you will see key summary stats of the activity, including any initial records broken.

steps.title: Confirm & Process
steps.description: Confirm saving the activity to immediately unlock its full, in-depth analytical report.

steps.title: Detailed Analytics
steps.description: Explore power graphs, power segment durations, and peak outputs reached.

steps.title: Social & Coach Sharing
steps.description: Easily share reports with your coach or friends, or generate ready-to-post graphics for your social media followers.

steps.title: Custom Records
steps.description: Create and track custom targets: for example, if you regularly test yourself on a specific climb, track your time progression in the custom records section.

whoWeAre.title: 1. Who we are
whoWeAre.text: Best Ride ("we", "us", "our") is a cycling performance tracking web application created by Simone Fusar Bassini, also available as an installable Progressive Web App (PWA). This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, and how users can control their information.

authentication.title: 2. Authentication and account data
authentication.intro: Best Ride uses Google OAuth for authentication. We do not store passwords.
authentication.listIntro: When you sign in with Google, we receive and store the following information:

personalData.title: 3. Personal and cycling data we collect
personalData.intro: To provide personalized cycling performance analysis, we collect:
items: Total cycling distance and hours recorded

activityData.title: 4. Activity data
activityData.intro: Users can manually upload cycling activity files in .fit format. These files may contain:
items: GPS coordinates, if available in the file
activityData.retention: Uploaded activities are processed to calculate performance metrics, training load, personal records, and other cycling statistics. Processed activity data is retained until the user uploads a newer activity file or deletes their account.

gps.title: 5. Use of GPS data
gps.text: If GPS information is included in an uploaded activity file, it may be used to display the route map of the cycling activity. GPS data is not used for advertising or tracking purposes.

whyWeProcess.title: 6. Why we process your data
whyWeProcess.intro: We process your data only to provide Best Ride's core functionality, including:
whyWeProcess.outro: We do not sell personal data and we do not use personal information for advertising purposes.

legalBasis.title: 7. Legal basis
legalBasis.text: We process personal data based on your consent and because processing is necessary to provide the service you requested, according to Article 6(1)(a) and 6(1)(b) of the GDPR.

dataRetention.title: 8. Data retention
dataRetention.text: Your personal data is stored while your account remains active. You can delete your account at any time using the account deletion feature available in the application. Account deletion removes your associated personal data.

security.title: 9. Data security
security.text: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

gdprRights.title: 10. Your rights under GDPR
items: Receive your data in a portable format

thirdParty.title: 11. Third-party services
thirdParty.text: Best Ride uses Google OAuth to authenticate users. Google may process personal data according to its own privacy policy.
